verdict.rationale: Creating bootable installer media is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers Migration Assistant, file transfer from a PC and running Windows on a Mac, but none of it documents creating a bootable USB installer or installing macOS from one. Those are adjacent onboarding features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can create bootable installation media and install the OS from a USB stick
